'''2010 Worlds Day 3 Justin Desai DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Justin Desai]] at [[2010 World Championship]] (Day 3).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 3
